preamble: Backing of the open nasal vowel [ã] to [ɑ̃]. In French, the Old French nasal /ã/ of an, chant and of former /ẽ/ words such as dent and enfant became /ɑ̃/ in the modern standard language, now realized as rounded [ɒ̃] in Paris, while Quebec French keeps front [ã] (vent /vã/, temps /tã/).

examples.from: Old French chant with /ã/ (< Latin cantum)
